notes: Reference date 2018-04-17. Governing document: the 2014-2017 Faculty Federation agreement (2018_01), continuing in force pending its successor (version note); the 2017-2020 successor (2018_02, signed 2019-04-18) has the same leave text (Art. XI.C.7-8) but is not coded from. The HR Guidelines for Administering Faculty FMLA (2018_05, dated 2008-10-14) govern how faculty FMLA leave is administered (version note); where they differ from the agreement, the agreement governs.

2018_03 (Faculty Handbook leaves page) holds no policy of its own: it describes sabbaticals and says leaves 'related to disability, family care' are described on the HR web site and in the agreement. 2018_04 (HR FMLA page) is an index of links only.

The agreement contains no maternity, parental or paid childbirth leave and no modified duties. Its 'Family Leave' clause (Art. XI.C.7.d) applies the FMLA and adds a tenure-decision extension for new parents and prorated tenure credit for part-time family-leave appointments; it refers to 'unpaid family leave' and to 'a leave as described in the paragraph above' without stating any leave beyond the FMLA, so the only longer leave is the HR guideline's semester extension (c2).

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) concurrent with UMD's semester leave (c2, an entire semester, normally just over 16 weeks), both from the start; own accrued sick leave (c3) paid within the FMLA leave first, then (own serious health condition only) the Sick Leave Bank (c4) five days after sick leave runs out; unpaid for the rest of the leave. No employer-funded paid leave (sick leave and the bank are own-balance pay, R1/R1d).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1) concurrent with the semester leave (c2); own sick leave usable only for illness of a family member (up to 10 days a year, c3); otherwise unpaid. The Sick Leave Bank is limited to the employee's own serious health condition (2018_05 (3A)).

Tenure clock: one-year tenure-decision extension on request for a biological or adoptive parent of a child under three (c5, discretionary); the general elective stay of probation for cause (c6, general_purpose); no accrual of time toward tenure during the unpaid period of FMLA leave (c7). The guidelines also say course evaluations for the leave year use only the semester not covered by the leave (2018_05 (5)), and members on unpaid leave are deemed to meet salary-increase requirements (Art. XI.A.3.a); neither is a component.

Provisions for other groups recorded and not counted: sick leave of librarians, technicians, part-time lecturers and research/technical associates (c10-c13); annual/personal/vacation leave of librarians, technicians and research/technical associates (c14-c18, general_purpose); part-time family-leave appointments for librarians and technicians (c9). Part-time lecturers are eligible for the Family Leave and Sick Leave Bank articles (Art. XV.E) and full-time lecturers for all provisions; clinical nursing faculty receive full-time lecturers' benefits.

Documents cited but not saved: the University's Family Medical Leave Act Policy (2018_05, 'shall dictate the eligibility, application and approval process'); HR links 'Change to FMLA eligibility Effective March 1, 2012', 'Your Rights under FMLA', the FMLA forms and certifications (2018_04); the HR web site descriptions of disability and family-care leaves (2018_03); the Health and Welfare Fund Agreement and Declaration of Trust (Art. XI.C.10); the Board of Trustees' established policies on wages, hours and conditions (Art. VI.H); the Higher Education Coordinating Council tuition remission policy; the Board of Trustees travel policy; Administrative Standards T96-129 (2018_02).
No leave limit or all-sources paid cap is stated. Calendar: semesters (16 weeks, R8).
